_doc: GOAL-CHECKPOINT-PACKET-2026-09-29 C1. Inventory of every prereg/decision that names the 2026-09-29 or 2026-10-30 checkpoint, tagged reduction|expansion|shadow-read|tooling. Classification rule (per goal): a change that can ONLY reduce risk/exposure (retire a shadow, tighten, remove) is 09-29-eligible; anything that adds entries/size/loosens a gate is an EXPANSION routed to 10-30 regardless of its numbers. Consumed by setup/scripts/checkpoint_packet.py -- hand-maintained, not generated. [2026-09-05 GOAL-FLEET-CAPTURE-GAP-2026-09-05 F4: +2 rows, fleet-capture-gap-mechanism1-gate-override + fleet-capture-gap-mechanism6-sizing-floor, both checkpoint=2026-10-30.] [2026-09-05 GOAL-RIGHT-TAIL-FOLLOWUPS-2026-09-05 T4: +1 row, runner-target-vs-tape-peak, checkpoint=2026-10-30.]
method: grep -l '09-29\|10-30' analysis/recommendations/*.json *.md, cross-referenced against the nine decisions named verbatim in automation/state/goals/GOAL-CHECKPOINT-PACKET-2026-09-29.md DONE-WHEN.

rows.classification_reason: Question is whether to REVERT max_same_day_roundtrips from 4 back to 5 -- that loosens a gate (more same-day entries admitted), so per the goal's routing rule it is an expansion and goes to 10-30 regardless of how the evidence reads.
rows.frozen_hypothesis: Does the forward window show control #4 (max_same_day_roundtrips=4, live since 2026-08-31) refusing any entry that would have exited >=1.3x? If yes, the churn control is costing the right tail and 4->5 is reverted. If no, it stays.

The cap stays.' Scored by right_tail_capture.py's would_be_refused_under_cap4 flag, post-08-31 (cap live) subset only.
rows.reversible_action: Revert one line in both automation/state/params.json and aggressive/params.json (max_same_day_roundtrips 4->5) -- REVERT line already documented in the key's own doc. EXPANSION, so even a clean revert-would-help finding waits for 10-30.
